# KiloBuilds

> Custom Claude Code automations for D2C Shopify Plus brands and performance
> agencies: catalog sync, ad creative pipelines, and internal tools, deployed
> directly into your own stack in days, not months.

KiloBuilds is run by David Akilo, an AI Systems Engineer based remotely in
Lagos, Nigeria. Audit sprints start from $150. Clients own 100% of the code
and infrastructure that gets built — everything deploys onto the client's own
accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, n8n, or a cloud VPS) using the client's own
API keys. No vendor lock-in, no proprietary platform fee.

## Services

- Multi-Store Catalog & Translation Pipelines: https://kilobuilds.com/services/multi-store-catalog-translation/
- AI Ad Creative Engines: https://kilobuilds.com/services/ai-ad-creative-engines/
- Custom SaaS Replacements & Internal Tools: https://kilobuilds.com/services/custom-saas-replacements-internal-tools/
- Competitor Intelligence & Content Ops: https://kilobuilds.com/services/competitor-intelligence-content-ops/

## Process

An Audit & Build Sprint ($150) is a focused, 3-to-5-day technical sprint
built around one real workflow bottleneck. It includes an audit of current
tools and data flow, a mapped automation architecture, and a working
prototype wired directly into the client's stack — plus a fixed-price build
quote for full production if wanted, with the $150 credited toward it.
Larger, multi-system builds are scoped per project. Ongoing/retainer
engagements are available after the initial sprint.
